Zoe Chen: Quick question — can anyone confirm the PTO carryover limit for full-time employees? Also, are there any company-wide blackout dates for December this year?
Aisha (People Ops): Hi Zoe :wave: Yes — carryover is capped at 40 hours for FT staff. Any carried hours must be used by Mar 31 of the following year or they expire.
Mike L.: Thanks Aisha. Is that prorated for folks who joined mid-year?
Aisha (People Ops): Good question — accruals are prorated based on your start date and FTE. If you were part-time, your carryover cap is pro-rated (we calculate on your FTE percentage).
Dan R.: What about contractors / external temps? Do they get carryover?
Aisha (People Ops): Contractors and vendors do not participate in PTO carryover. Their time off should be handled per contract and vendor agreement.
Zoe Chen: Got it. And blackout dates? We have a couple of product launches late Dec so want to check approval rules.
Aisha (People Ops): We do have recommended blackout guidance: Dec 20–31 is a soft blackout for major releases and org-wide changes — meaning managers should avoid approving large, cross-team releases then. It isn't a hard PTO ban, but please coordinate with your manager if you need time off during that window.
Mike L.: If someone needs to take 5 days in the blackout window for family reasons, is that escalated?
Aisha (People Ops): No automatic escalation. Manager approval is required as usual. If a role is critical to a scheduled launch, the manager should propose coverage or a swap. If team impact is high, escalate to your director and cc people-ops.
Zoe Chen: Any special process for requesting carryover beyond 40h?
Aisha (People Ops): Exceptions can be requested in writing. Please submit to people-ops@redwood.com with the subject line: "PTO Carryover Exception — <Employee Name>" and include: 1) total carryover requested, 2) reason (brief), 3) proposed use-by date. Managers should reply with approval/denial.
Dan R.: Is there a self-serve place in Rippling to mark carryover?
Aisha (People Ops): You don't mark carryover in Rippling directly. Rippling will show accrued balance; at year close we automatically move up to 40h into the next year's balance. If an exception is approved, we update balances manually and notify payroll.
Mike L.: Can you paste a short template for the exception email?
Aisha (People Ops): Sure — copy/paste this: ```Subject: PTO Carryover Exception — Zoe Chen
Hi People Ops,
I request carryover of 48 hours (8 hours over the standard 40h cap) due to project delays. I plan to use the excess hours by 2026-03-15. Manager approval: Mike L. (attached).
Thanks,
Zoe```

Zoe Chen: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll coordinate with Mike and submit if needed.
Aisha (People Ops): Happy to help. Ping me if the dates overlap with a launch and we'll work through coverage. :thumbsup:
